workflow.description: S14c (bản da đen), khung đầu S82 → S90. Tải vào mỗi node IMG_ ảnh đã chọn ở 0A/0B/0C của node cùng tên (bỏ IMG_); ảnh thật: IMG_ACA_HOLDER, IMG_ACA_SET, IMG_WATERTEST. Chạy hết, mỗi khung chọn 1 ảnh đạt trong 4, tải về (Auto Download lưu theo tên node).

nodes.prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 photo, the first frame of a video shot, looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors and soft natural contrast; fine natural grain; the far background a touch softer than the foreground. No over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. Image 1 is the empty clean kitchen weeks later: the shot takes place in exactly this room, same furniture, same light; keep the background exactly as in Image 1. Image 2 is the grandmother's character sheet: use it only for her face, skin tone, silver hair, glasses on the chain, jewelry and clothes. Image 3 shows the teal silicone utensils: use it only for their shape and teal color. Image 4 is the real product photo of the wooden utensils. Medium shot. The photo shows weeks later in the clean kitchen, no boxes, the round wooden utensil holder with the wooden set on the counter; the grandmother in a soft blue cardigan holds up one leftover teal silicone ladle. The grandmother: a 71-year-old Black American woman with medium-deep brown skin and warm undertones, a round face, short tapered silver-white coily hair, gold-framed reading glasses hanging on a chain at her chest, small gold earrings and a small gold cross. She wears a soft blue cardigan over a cream blouse and the same floral cotton apron. ACAWOOD SET: solid deep-brown acacia wood utensils with visible natural grain, each carved from a single piece, matte oiled finish (not glossy, not varnished), a small hanging hole near the end of each handle. Exactly seven utensils in the full set: a ladle, a wok spatula, a slotted spoon, a turner, a serving spoon, a mixing spoon and a small spoon. The utensils keep the exact shape of the real product photo. Lighting match: the wooden utensils are lit by exactly the same light as the rest of the scene: the same direction, color temperature, softness and exposure, with soft highlights on the side facing the main light and matching shade on the far side, a soft contact shadow where they touch the counter, towel or a hand. The same grain, softness and color grade as the rest of the photo, the same perspective, and a realistic size (the ladle about 33 cm long). Use Image 4 only for the shapes, number, grain and color of the wood; ignore its lighting, background and shadows. It must look photographed together in one shot, never pasted in or cut out. Expressions true to this moment: the grandmother warm and dry, with a slightly mischievous smile; natural and believable, never exaggerated or posed. Every hand has five fingers in natural proportion and a natural grip; each person has exactly two arms and two hands; nothing floats. She looks straight into the lens, as if talking to a friend across the counter. Look: bright, clean, warm daylight kitchen. Skin as a real camera sees it from a couple of meters away: natural, with subtle texture and slight unevenness, not retouched, not over-detailed; no airbrushed, waxy or plastic skin. Brown skin true to life: each person keeps their own skin depth and undertone, with soft natural highlights and visible detail in the shadows; palms lighter than the backs of the hands; never grey, ashy or lightened. Final check: the grandmother is the same woman as in her character sheet, with the same skin tone, silver hair, glasses on the chain and gold jewelry. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.
